help: You believe that might makes right, and manifest fascist anger to brutalize your foes. Blight Melee attacks are slow, but heavy handed, with a small chance to drain endurance. Blight Melee attacks initially emphasize physical prowess in the one-on-one setting, dealing primarily smashing damage with a negative energy component. As your will to power is realized, your attacks will sprawl across the battlefield, and deal equal parts smashing and negative damage.
